'''Don't use this image on any other router - for WRH54G only !''' Linksys WRH54G is now supported by dd-wrt. No need to replace cfe, but you alwayays need to use special firmware built for wrh54g only. Even for later GUI upgrades. # Restore to defaults # Open upgrade page, select [ftp://dd-wrt.com/others/eko/V24_TNG/svn12548/dd-wrt.v24-12548_WRH54G_micro.bin dd-wrt.v24-12548_WRH54G_micro.bin] (or other special wrh image) # Upgrade # When it comes back, be sure to press reset button for 5 s to restore dd-wrt's factory defaults *** that's it *** ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/linksys/linksys_wrh54g_10 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/linksys/wrh54g |forumpage = |forumpage2 = |forumpage3 = |github = |target = brcm47xx |subtarget = legacy |arch = mipsel_mips32 |support_started_version = unknown |current_supported_version = EOL |last_supported_version = unknown |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = [https://openwrt.org/unsupported/possible_to_support Possible to support] |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ==Reverting== ===Reverting dd-wrt=== # Download WRH54G firmware from Linksys
# Restore to defaults
# Open upgrade page, select the firmware
# Upgrade
# When it comes back, be sure to press reset button for 5 s to restore Linksys's factory defaults
